title: menu-nav: Shared list/menu navigation keybindings
summary: Single configurable binding set for list/menu navigation on overlay-layer navigable surfaces: contextual menu, command palette, future top-bar menu. Sidebar is OUT — it has its own configurable [keys.mode] name="sidebar" and does NOT migrate.
description: Flat [keys] bindings: menu_up (ArrowUp + Ctrl+k), menu_down (ArrowDown + Ctrl+j), menu_activate (Enter), menu_dismiss (Esc). Applied to context menu + command palette + future topbar (surfaces that today hardcode nav keys in their widgets). The widgets (ContextMenu, CommandPalette) become intent-only for nav: remove hardcoded arrow/Ctrl+j/k from widget event(); the host resolves via the configurable keymap and dispatches nav actions. Sidebar keeps its own [keys.mode] name="sidebar" (already configurable, has sidebar_up/down + tree-nav h/l + mutation keys). Single-letter quick-pick stays menu-widget-specific. Decision 2026-07-09: sidebar does NOT migrate onto menu-nav (corrects the original backlog text).
